summary: migration_bridge.py materializes Quick Dev RED test files for slices R0/R1/R2; CLI requires repository_root, plan_dir, slice_id, snapshot_path, and materialize_only; rejects when materialize_only absent or slice_id not declared; TEMPLATES maps R0 to acceptance coordinator trust test, R1 to successor crash recovery test, R2 to authorization refresh chain plus degraded knowledge context test; writes only if target missing or content identical, otherwise exits conflict; creates parent dirs and writes LF UTF-8; outputs JSON with test_paths and empty authorizes; R0 test expects v3 coordinator request accepted far enough to fail on missing coordinator bundle; R1 test expects reserve_successor_run idempotently reuses identical lineage and writes successor-lineage.v1.json; R2 tests require refresh_context_read_set API in quick-dev and acceptance knowledge_context modules; plan_dir and snapshot_path parsed but unused; ambiguity: bridge authorizes none despite materializing tests
